problem_type: Merge admission confuses hosted display counts and lossy patches with complete immutable tree evidence
symptom: Original PR #2 false clean and rename count rejection were corrected; real run58 then fails closed with ENOBUFS because unrelated forced-text binary patches exceed 64MiB. D also confirms pre-existing cross-line constructor false clean from artificial + prefixes.
direct_cause: Earlier failures came from lost diff, unknown-cutoff exemption, rename-count strong equality, missing unchanged objects and attribute-hidden text. In 33eca every changed blob is rendered as full text even though content classification only needs cancellation tokens, and adding an artificial + to each added line prevents the unchanged new\s+Ctor predicate from matching across lines.
class_root: Admission must prove full object/tree/path/patch coverage for immutable PR endpoints separately from hosted rename presentation, and unknown evidence cannot create success or historical exemption.
affected_population: Large PRs with differing rename heuristics
Missing commit/tree/blob or malformed endpoint metadata
Binary attributes and arbitrary file suffixes
internal_only_reason: The defect is internal error-to-success conversion. Reuse the repository's existing Git path decoder and actual local Git executable; regression uses real commit objects and isolated gh transport fixtures, without asserting hosted network behavior.
invariants: Resolve complete PR metadata from the requested target repository and PR number, with explicit base/head commit SHAs and changed_files
Read paths and added lines from the same SHA-bound three-point Git diff, never the current checkout or an unbound hosted diff
Validate complete raw tree path coverage before classification; hosted rename counts must lie within raw-min(A,D) through raw, not equal one guessed threshold
Check all local snapshot blobs and tree traversal; every Git subprocess blocks all protocols with scoped GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL even when old Git ignores NO_LAZY_FETCH

Force candidate file patches as text without textconv/external diff and preserve the 64MiB output ceiling; attributes and arbitrary suffixes cannot hide cancellation text; a distinct native added-line indicator prevents source/header ambiguity
One cancellation token owner derives both the original JS predicate and Git -G conservative superset; only content patch is filtered, never raw tree/path/blob verification or path classification
Filtered NUL candidate paths are a unique exact-status raw subset; combined native raw identity plus patch must agree with candidates and snapshot modes/OIDs; empty candidate requires empty output
Native content reads must exit zero and fit the unchanged 64MiB limit; unrelated large binary data may be skipped only by -G, while oversized relevant content still fails
Added text strips only the native diff indicator, preserving source ++ and whitespace across added lines for the original predicate
Historical exemption requires two valid timestamps and a strictly earlier createdAt; unknown policy time enforces current rules
Keep four-class, design-card and independent-acceptance rules unchanged; the existing src/**/*.tsx path wildcard must include legal newline filenames

door_reduction.why_not: Generated by mapDoors/doorsForTargets over scripts including tests, with HEAD source as before and saved source as after, for prior Git/tree/classification boundaries plus readCancellationPatch and the three shared cancellation-token bindings. Existing 25 consumer files remain counted. Four new internal read doors centralize the predicate/superset and candidate-patch proof; no alternate gate, global env change or content suffix exclusion is introduced.

generality_proof: Full tree/object/path proof and conservative path classification remain unfiltered. One token owner derives the original JS predicate and a conservative native -G file superset, including arbitrary suffixes and forced binary text. Candidate paths are an exact-status raw subset; the same native capture returns candidate mode/OID/status/path identities plus patches, checked against snapshots and the candidate list before decoding real added text. Empty candidates require empty capture. Finite 65MiB fixtures prove unfiltered overflow, filtered success without discarding any raw path, and continued failure for oversized relevant candidates. Actual main blocks a cross-line constructor with only star cells/no independent verifier and accepts its full card. Existing missing-object, protocol, metadata, rename, binary and legacy negatives remain enforced.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind target repository/PR metadata and fail before classification when complete evidence is unavailable
Prove exact immutable tree/path/text coverage and mathematically feasible hosted rename grouping
Traverse all three snapshot trees and batch-check their blobs before trusting a diff
Own tokens used to derive both the unchanged JS predicate and native Git superset
Prove candidate identity/subset and a successful bounded native text read; decode raw added lines without artificial markers
Preserve canonical NUL parsing while forwarding per-invocation transport prohibition and buffer cap
Require positive chronological evidence for historical exemption

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual standalone subprocess uses real local Git and isolated failing hosted-diff/policy transport
The same main body is exercised with malformed metadata, missing objects and valid legacy evidence

Optional env/maxBuffer forwarding is tested with a missing tree in a promisor repo; transport canary remains uninvoked even without NO_LAZY_FETCH. Existing callers retain inherited defaults and NUL semantics.

recurrence.reason: Any rename algorithm, unavailable object, attribute setting or partial clone can repeat this class; a matching hosted number does not prove completeness.
same_class_scan: Read complete PR acquisition and policy/report tail
Read canonical Git NUL parser and its process environment defaults
Compared user-supplied real M50/M100/raw counts without selecting a threshold
Executed true edited/exact-rename Git fixtures and complete path mutation controls
Verified actual Apple Git 2.39.3 and isolated promisor transport positive/negative controls
Checked binary attributes, arbitrary suffixes and ++ source lines
Retained original classification/card/acceptance and strict-cutoff regressions

prevention.invariant: Complete tree/object/path proof is mandatory; cancellation content is a shared-token native superset with matched candidate identities and bounded full capture, never an unverified empty patch
prevention.failure_mode: Any object/path/identity/range/candidate/patch inconsistency or 64MiB overflow returns nonzero; unknown policy stays strict; all Git protocols remain prohibited
prevention.strategy: Retain full raw tree proof, filter only content with native -G from shared predicate tokens, verify combined raw identity and patch, then strip only native added indicators and preserve source whitespace/++

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove all-file textual patch rendering, raw-count/nonempty-content equivalence and artificial + prefixes; earlier false-success/count/attribute losses stay removed. Preserve every raw A/D path, the original predicate and valid legacy compatibility.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No package or installed-Git replacement. The application now enforces transport prohibition with the stable GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL contract, verified on Apple Git 2.39.3 and with NO_LAZY_FETCH deliberately removed. No new dependency or production fetch is introduced.

migration: No project data migration. Callers must provide all three snapshot trees/blobs locally; missing data fails without implicit transport. Gitlinks are external commit pointers, not required local submodule objects.
residual_risks: Real PR rerun and independent D review remain coordination acceptance; no real network request made here
No App/browser/benchmark/workflow/heavy gate; coordinator build61, PNGs and daily project remain untouched
The hosted interval checks rename feasibility only; exact full raw tree/path proof is still mandatory
A relevant token-bearing candidate can still exceed the unchanged 64MiB cap and must fail closed; unrelated payload is excluded only from content patch by native -G
Object checks cover three snapshots, not whole-history fsck or submodule checkout
Native Git successful exit and bounded complete capture own patch-body completeness; no separate homegrown unified-patch engine is introduced
